messages:
jordan: Heads up — hourly billing ingest shows a 42% jump in untagged GPU cost in us-east-1 between 01:00-02:00 UTC. AcmeCorp invoice doesn't match dashboard. Anyone seeing this?
finance-bot: [automated] Billing ingest pipeline alert: untagged_gpu_hours increased by 42% vs baseline. link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/ingest?ts=1783456789 :warning:
leila: :eyes: I'll pull the allocation logs now. curious if it's tagging or a meter duplicate.
leila: running query: 
```
SELECT team_label, SUM(gpu_hours) AS hrs
FROM billing_raw.hourly
WHERE region='us-east-1' AND ts >= '2026-03-20T01:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-20T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY team_label;
```
leila: result: team_label=NULL -> 1,082 hrs; acme -> 420 hrs; others normal.
sabin: that NULL looks like a missing k8s label. saw this last month with the ad-hoc notebook pool.
ops-oncall: which nodepool? I can check infra tags and possibly drain.
leila: pods are from nodepool id np-playground-3a. Owner label absent. Appears to be an automated notebook job that escaped autoscaler tagging.
sabin: confirmed. np-playground-3a had a recent rollout yesterday — a terraform change dropped tag propagation for ephemeral nodes.
ops-oncall: draining nodepool now. I'll cordon + drain. ETA ~5m :hammer_and_wrench:
ops-oncall: done. removed nodes, restarted autoscaler tagging job. :white_check_mark:
gita: can billing backfill retroactively attribute those hours to the playground/experiments budget? We need to avoid charging AcmeCorp for internal experiments.
leila: pipeline supports retro attribution if we reprocess hourly files and apply team mappings. I'll open billing ticket and schedule a backfill run.
leila: ticket created: BILL-3247 - "us-east hourly reprocess for NULL team_label on np-playground-3a". Target window: last 48 hours.
jordan: sales notified? Need a customer credit preemptively if the invoice is imminent.
finance-bot: Reminder: billing cycle cutoff in 18 hours for some customers in this batch. :alarm_clock:
jordan: @sales-team can you prepare a provisional credit for AcmeCorp for the affected window? We'll confirm after backfill.
sabin: also adding a nightly check to alert on nodepools missing owner_label. I'll add a quick rule to infra-monitoring.
leila: after backfill we'll verify tokenized charges and update ledger. Expect processed in ~3 hours once queue clears.
jordan: thanks all. please add short note in BILL-3247 with final allocation and the amount to credit. :pray:
ops-oncall: note: ops changed tf -> module/nodepool to ensure label propagation. PR 7892 created.
leila: update: backfill started (job id rback-20260320-01). will post results here when done.
finance-bot: Backfill job rback-20260320-01 completed: reattributed 1,082 gpu_hours to playground (internal). Estimated invoice delta: -$12,400 for AcmeCorp this cycle. :money_with_wings:
jordan: perfect — please attach ledger diff and we'll close the loop with sales.
leila: attached ledger diff to BILL-3247 and flagged for accounting review.
sales-team: ack, prepping client note and provisional credit memo.
